subject: Clarifying hosted evaluation path, sandbox endpoints & rate expectations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@sterlingretail.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@medisys.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying hosted evaluation path, sandbox endpoints & rate expectations

Hi Samir / Elena,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through the payment-fraud flow. I wanted to capture the plan we discussed and confirm what you need from us to progress the hosted evaluation: 

1) Quick recap of what Redwood will provide for a hosted evaluation:
- Sandbox endpoints (isolated tenant) for chat + embeddings + reranker routes.
- Baseline rate slice for evaluation (sustained RPS + short burst headroom).
- Prefix/KV caching enabled for sessionized workloads (helps reduce token cost for repeated user prompts).
- Access to our Quickstart Guide and a short onboarding call with an engineer.

2) Items we need from Sterling to scope the right footprint / tempo:
- Expected steady-state RPS and peak burst (example: 5k users/day, ~30 RPS sustained during peak).
- Typical prompt length distribution and avg tokens per call (we use this to estimate token cost).
- Any hard compliance/residency requirements (PCI scope questions, EU data residency, retention windows).

3) Proposed initial evaluation configuration (hosted):
- Sandbox quota: 20 RPS sustained, 100 RPS burst for 60s windows, 2M tokens/day cap for the first 2 weeks.
- Endpoints: POST /v1/chat (chat inference), POST /v1/embeddings, POST /v1/rerank.
- Monitoring: access to the Console trial dashboard (latency/cost per route) + weekly check-in.

If those starter limits look reasonable we can provision access today after you sign the basic trial terms (I attached the Redwood_Quickstart_Guide.pdf). If you expect sustained >100 RPS we should also scope a Dedicated capacity option and I can loop in Rishi to size it quickly.

Next steps: please share the short answers above (RPS, avg tokens, residency). I’ll provision sandbox credentials and book a 30-minute runthrough with our engineer once we have those.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Quickstart_Guide.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@sterlingretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@medisys.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying hosted evaluation path, sandbox endpoints & rate expectations

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PCI: our customer data touches card tokens in the flow, so we will need answers on scope and whether Redwood hosted keeps any PII. Can you confirm whether a hosted evaluation keeps request payloads or if there is an E2E option to avoid storage?

- Traffic: for a realistic test we’d like to push up to 100 RPS sustained for a short spike (5–10 minute window) and 500 RPS for a brief stress run (30–60s). Long-term we expect ~200 RPS steady for our initial rollout.

- Residency: Sterling’s legal prefers EU residency for customers in EU; we have a mixed footprint (US + EU). For the purposes of this hosted pilot, US residency is acceptable, but note EU will be required for production.

I attached our security questionnaire (Sterling_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — the security team will review the answers and loop in folks for a call if needed.

If hosted can’t meet the short high-throughput stress run, point us to the Dedicated sizing playbook and we’ll evaluate. Otherwise we’d prefer hosted for speed to market.

Samir
Head of Product | Sterling Retail
samir@sterlingretail.com
Attachment: Sterling_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 0.8MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@sterlingretail.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@medisys.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying hosted evaluation path, sandbox endpoints & rate expectations

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the questionnaire; I’ve started a security pass with our InfoSec team and attached a short note with the expected answers for the sections you flagged. A few clarifications and a concrete plan: 

1) Data handling (short answer): hosted evaluation tenants do not persist user payloads beyond short operational logs by default. We offer a "no-persist" evaluation option — request payloads can be disabled from being written to disk for the sandbox tenant; we will log telemetry (latency/usage) for troubleshooting. For production we have documented options for tokenization and PII redaction; InfoSec will confirm specifics on the questionnaire.

2) Throughput plan for evaluation:
- Immediate sandbox: provisioned at 20 RPS sustained with 100 RPS 60s burst (as a conservative starting point).
- Stress window: we can schedule a controlled stress test where we temporarily raise the sandbox to 500 RPS for a 60s window (requires an engineering-scheduled blast and will be supervised).
- Dedicated: if you need steady 200 RPS+ with predictable latency (SLO-backed), Dedicated is the recommended path — I can get you a preliminary sizing and price range within 24 hours.

3) EU residency: for production we can provision EU-hosted tenants (VPC-backed) or Private deployments. For the evaluation, US-hosted sandbox is typical; we can run an EU-located smoke test in a later phase if you want.

4) Endpoints & routes: we’ll map your test flows to the following endpoints by default: POST /v1/chat (streaming supported), POST /v1/embeddings, POST /v1/rerank. We’ll enable prefix caching for session lookups and provide a sample client snippet in the Quickstart Guide.

5) Proposed timeline:
- Today: confirm the RPS / token targets (you’ve given good numbers).
- Tomorrow: I provision sandbox tenant and send credentials + Quickstart instructions.
- Wed: 30-minute onboarding call with Rishi (engineer) to walk through the endpoints and run a small smoke test.
- After smoke: schedule a supervised stress test (500 RPS 60s) if you want to validate burst behavior.

Next steps for us internally: I’ll loop Rishi to size Dedicated and have Monica prep the trial dashboard invite. Does Wed 10:00am PT work for your team for the onboarding call?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184
Attachment: Redwood_Quickstart_Guide.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Sterling Retail — hosted eval ask + sizing follow-up

Folks — quick internal summary from the Sterling thread: 

- Customer: Sterling Retail (contact: Samir Patel). They prefer hosted for speed but want to validate stress behavior (up to 500 RPS short window) and have PCI-scoped parts of the flow. EU residency is required for production but US sandbox is OK for evaluation.

- Immediate asks: provision sandbox with the following windows (we agreed): 20 RPS sustained, 100 RPS 60s burst default; schedule supervised 500 RPS 60s stress test. Provide the Quickstart guide and sample client.

Action items: 
- Rishi: can you draft a Dedicated sizing note for a steady 200 RPS footprint (SLO targets: p95 < 150ms for chat) and an engineering estimate for executing the supervised 500 RPS stress run? Please include rough cost/slot counts so I can share with procurement.
- Monica: please create the trial tenant in Console, add Samir and Elena as trial users, and prepare the trial dashboard link. Also add the HubSpot deal link (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890) to the tenant notes.
- Security: I’ve already forwarded the Sterling_Security_Questionnaire.pdf to InfoSec; asking for a written response by EOD tomorrow.

I’ll wait for Rishi’s sizing before I send the Dedicated estimate to Samir. Wed 10am PT onboarding is tentatively OK — I’ll confirm once we have the tenant.

Thanks,

Marissa
